question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

In seventh heaven
solution:
The correct answer is **Extremely happy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom '**In Seventh Heaven**' is '**Extremely happy**'.
 
• **In Seventh Heaven**: A state of extreme joy.
